prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web dashboard hero redesign decision comp for eBuhay
Primary request: Create Option B, "Care Journey Rail", for an established Philippine donation and transplant demo. Show one 1536x1024 design board containing three realistic full-width dashboard opening sections stacked vertically: Recipient, Donor, and Hospital Administrator. Each strip must read as an actual responsive web application viewport crop, not a poster.
Structure: Every strip has a quiet white or cloud canvas and a 1200px content container. Use a wide editorial hero with the role-specific headline and concise copy in the upper left, a compact current-status lozenge aligned upper right, then a single full-width horizontal information rail below. The rail is one continuous working surface, not separate cards: a colored leading segment marks the current state, followed by three evenly spaced facts separated by thin dividers. No calls to action. Hint at the unchanged thin network band and pill tab navigation below each hero so the page mode is unmistakable.
Recipient content: label "RECIPIENT DASHBOARD"; headline "Your care journey, clearly in view."; supporting copy "Track your match status and the details guiding your next step."; current status "Clinical review in progress"; facts "Blood O+", "Kidney", "High urgency".
Donor content: label "DONOR DASHBOARD"; headline "Your pledge is ready when it matters."; supporting copy "Keep your donation details current while eBuhay looks for a compatible recipient."; current status "Registry active"; facts "Blood O-", "2 organs pledged", "Available".
Hospital content: label "HOSPITAL ADMINISTRATION"; headline "Philippine General Hospital"; supporting line "Match triage and institutional review"; identifier "PGH-MNL-1000"; location "Taft Avenue, Manila"; leading metric "8 Pending review"; facts "3 Approved matches", "1 Active procedure", "2 Consultations today".
Style/medium: polished high-fidelity web UI mockup, semantic HTML/CSS appearance, crisp text, no photography.
Color palette: eBuhay Blue #0038A8, navy #06145B, Lifeline Red #CE1126, Hope Gold #F59E0B, Recovery Green #059669, white #FFFFFF, cloud #F8FAFC, ink #0F172A, slate #64748B.
Typography: Figtree-like bold friendly civic headings; Noto Sans-like body; disciplined tight hierarchy.
Materials: white and pale-cloud working surfaces, 1px pale slate borders, 12-16px corners, restrained ambient shadows.
Focal moment: the continuous status rail across the lower half of each hero; the rest remains quiet and airy.
Constraints: This is visibly an eBuhay demo/prototype dashboard, not an official government portal. Preserve role distinction. No behavior changes, no buttons, no illustrations, no gradients, no dotted grids, no blur blobs, no glassmorphism, no huge title filling the screen, no bento grid, no emoji, no fake official seals, no DICT endorsement, no medical claims, no real patient data, no watermark.
